name: The Aurora
description: A transformation that lessened kithkin kindness, deepened paranoia, robbed beings of their halves, and replaced changelings' innocence with malice.

description_citations.text: Eventide: card flavor text (Eventide, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Aurora transforms Nibb and Gyik from mischief-makers into feral marauders.
timeline.quote: The Aurora transformed Nibb and Gyik from mischief-makers into feral marauders.

citation.text: Boggart Arsonists (Shadowmoor, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Aurora lessens kithkin kindness, deepens their paranoia and dulls their sense of pain.
timeline.quote: The Aurora had lessened the kithkins' kindness, deepened their paranoia, and dulled their sense of pain.

citation.text: Endure (Eventide, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Aurora transforms Ashling into a relentless force of destruction.
timeline.quote: The Aurora had transformed her into a relentless force of destruction.

citation.text: Ashling, the Extinguisher (Eventide, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Aurora replaces changelings' innocence with malice.
timeline.quote: The Aurora replaced the changelings' innocence with malice and their curiosity with hunger.

citation.text: Shorecrasher Mimic (Eventide, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A magical transformation that remade Lorwyn into Shadowmoor and turned boggarts such as Nibb and Gyik feral.

citation.text: Shadowmoor: card flavor text (Shadowmoor, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
